scope: Re-pins of scoped UltraBERT runtime sources frozen in tools/ci-heavy/ultrabert_scifact.py PINS. The frozen digests, historical receipts and every retrieval/numerical result are unchanged; this file only lets the driver and its contract test accept later reviewed, default-preserving edits. No inference was repeated and no model, budget or default changed.

initial_failure.cause: PR #89 (merged 2ecd1fbb) changed two pinned UltraBERT sources for its gated Q4_K/Q8/Unicode-tokenizer paths. The model-free controls only ran on its own paths before; the auditor stops at the first mismatch, so src/ultrabert_profile.h drift was hidden behind it.
